column1: # Altin: the water beasts and the rain that does not stop.

column3: Is this your first time\nto visit Altin?{end_now}

Look at what's left of
Altin.{page_break}The lower streets are
underwater. We carried
out what we could.{end_wait}
We look like a coastal\ntown now, don't we?{end_now}

We never had enough
water in the old days.{page_break}Now the beasts have
flooded our homes.
Nothing seems fair.{end_wait}

The creatures appeared
after the stones fell
from the sky.{page_break}Then the water rose.
No one knows why the
statues came alive.{end_wait}
How can those creatures\nspit up so much water?{end_wait}
My house is soaked\nthrough. The monsters\nand the rain did it.{end_wait}
The mine is flooded.\nWithout it, we have\nno wages or food.{end_wait}
If someone destroyed\nthe monsters, the water\nmight drain away.{end_wait}
We used to pray for\nwater. Now we pray\nfor it to stop.{end_wait}

Don't drink that water.
We don't know where
it came from.{page_break}The children are thirsty.
What am I meant to
tell them?{end_wait}

The water here has
subsided...{page_break}I wonder if the holes in
the mine drained it.
The rain still falls.{end_wait}

The water beasts looked
like Altin's guardian
statues...{page_break}Did the guardians turn
into the monsters
when the light came?{end_wait}

The flood washed rock
out of the mine.{page_break}Some see treasure.
I see the men who
were trapped below.{end_wait}
You came to Altin at\na bad time. Terrible\nluck, you strangers.{end_wait}
It's as if they turn\nthe air itself into\nwater!{end_wait}

I saved an old letter.
Everything else is
underwater.{page_break}It seemed foolish then.
Now I'm glad I kept it.{end_wait}

Even the strongest
miners refuse to go
down there.{page_break}They know what a cave
can do when the ground
is unstable.{end_wait}
If the water beasts\nkeep flooding us,{page_break}the whole village\nwill go under.{end_wait}
Water is nice, but not\nwhen it takes your home.{end_wait}
Ugh. The monsters\nspewed all this water.\nIt smells foul...{end_wait}

As the monsters go away,
the waters recede.{page_break}Perhaps all of them
will be gone soon.
The rain, though...{end_wait}
Come to think of it,\nour guardian statue\nseemed to spew water.{end_wait}

We can start mining
again once the shafts
are safe.{page_break}I won't send anyone
down there before that.{end_wait}
Oh no... The whole\nhouse is soaked...{end_wait}

If the monster that did
this were here, I would
give him a smack!{page_break}Just kidding... I
am against violence.
Mostly.{end_wait}
It will take a lot of\nwork to repair this\nhouse.{end_wait}
One blow isn't enough.\nJab! Jab! Hook! Then\ncomes the uppercut!{end_wait}
Are you trying to find\nyour way west through\nthe mountains?{end_now}
There should be a\npassage at the bottom\nof the mine.{end_wait}

You stopped the beasts.
I don't know how to
thank you.{page_break}There's still so much
left to repair.{end_wait}

Those beasts were once
our guardian statues.{page_break}I don't know whether
to mourn them or fear
what changed them.{end_wait}

I thought Altin was
finished.{page_break}The water is falling.
Maybe we can begin
again after all.{end_wait}
I'm just glad to\nhave my house back.{end_wait}
I didn't want to leave\nmy hometown...\nThat is why I came back.{end_wait}

I heard someone killed
the water beasts.
That is why I came back.{page_break}There's no place
like home.{end_wait}
You defeated those\nmonsters, didn't you?{end_now}
Here, let me thank\nyou with...a kiss!{page_break}Look, you're turning\nbeet-red!{end_wait}

Oh, you didn't? Still, I
am glad to be home,
so here is a kiss!{page_break}Look, you're turning
beet-red!{end_wait}

At the bottom of the
eastern passage...{page_break}There is something
my husband found.
I won't forget it.{end_wait}

My husband's sense for
treasure never failed.{page_break}When the water recedes,
we will dig up the spot
he found.{end_wait}

Mom and Pop know
something about the
bottom of the mine.{page_break}I wish they would
tell me what it is.{end_wait}
Do you want weapons?{end_now}

I'll sell you anything
once the waters have
receded.{page_break}What did we do
to deserve this?{end_wait}
You wouldn't say that\nif you saw my weapons.\nI wish I could show you.{end_wait}
Thank goodness the water\nhas receded. I can open\nthe shop again!{end_wait}
Cripes... Is this how\nmy weapon shop ends,\nas a sunken wreck?{end_wait}
Only a merchant knows\nthe joy of opening the\ndoors again.{end_wait}
My store is submerged.\nI want to sell armor,\nbut I can't.{end_wait}
It's good to sell\narmor out of my own\nshop again.{end_wait}
All my armor is rusting\nas we speak.{end_wait}
We dried all the armor\nand polished it.{page_break}There should be no\ntrace of rust now.{end_wait}
Oh no! What will I do\nif all my merchandise\nis soaked?{end_wait}
None of my goods were\ndamaged. I'll sell\nlike there's no tomorrow!{end_wait}
If my goods are wet, I\nhave to dry them out\nbefore I can sell them.{end_wait}

A few things got damp...{page_break}It shouldn't affect
the quality, so you can
use them safely.{page_break}...Maybe I should put
up a sign to say so.{end_wait}
We were lucky. Only\na little water got\ninto our rooms.{end_now}
Others lost their\nhomes and their work.\nWe can spare a bed.{end_wait}

Some people have lost
everything they owned.{page_break}They'll need help
long after the water
is gone.{end_wait}

I'd give anything to have
Altin back the way it was.{page_break}You look young, but if
you can fight, please help.
We can't do it alone.{end_wait}
I came here from Xian.\nI cook for the miners.\nPlease, eat something.{end_wait}
None of us can go\nhome until the\nwater subsides.{end_wait}
The guests in Room One\nwent home when the\nwaters receded.{end_wait}
The guests in Room Two\nalso went home when the\nwaters receded.{end_wait}
We'll survive this.\nWe have to.{page_break}But saying that won't\nrebuild a single home.{end_wait}

I know they don't look
tough, but they are
warriors,{page_break}so maybe they can
help us.{end_wait}
I learned to cook\nbefore I came to Altin.{page_break}At least I can still\nfeed the people here.{end_wait}

Most of the village is
still submerged...{page_break}It will be a long time
before Altin is what
it was.{end_wait}

The water has receded
a little,{page_break}but it will be a long
time before Altin is
what it was.{end_wait}
No matter what happens,\nI will never abandon\nAltin.{end_wait}

Our house is ruined.
My husband says we
should stay.{page_break}I don't know whether
I have the strength.{end_wait}
Leave Altin for Tolbi?\nWe don't even have\nthe money to travel.{end_wait}
I used to dream of\nmoving to Tolbi.{page_break}Now I can't imagine\nleaving Altin behind.{end_wait}
Few people come up\nSilk Road to Altin.\nYou are an odd lot.{end_wait}
I used to complain\nabout housework.{page_break}I'd give anything\nfor an ordinary day.{end_wait}
You can't go west\nof the mountains\nwithout Silk Road.{end_wait}
I'm tired of waiting.\nI want to go home.{page_break}But there's still\nwater in the street.{end_wait}
Thank you for defeating\nthe water beasts\nin the mine.{end_wait}
Did you see water gush\nout when you slew those\nhydros creatures?{end_now}
I see... So the water\nmonsters were like\ngiant water tanks...{end_wait}
Really... Then how did\nthey carry all that\nwater?{end_wait}
Once the mine is safe,\nwe can return to work.{page_break}It won't be easy,\nbut we have to try.{end_wait}

The upper shafts are
open again.{page_break}No one will work below
until we know they're
safe.{end_wait}

The water drained out
through the cracks,
as I expected.{page_break}The rain still falls,
and the remaining water
will sit for a while.{end_wait}
The beasts are gone.\nAt last, the water\nis going down.{end_wait}
Are you the ones who\ndefeated the water\nbeasts?{end_now}
If you can spare time,\nwe still need help\nrebuilding the village.{end_wait}
They say our rescuers\nwere young travelers.{page_break}I wish I could\nthank them myself.{end_wait}
The monsters are gone,\nbut the damage remains.{page_break}It will take months\nto rebuild Altin.{end_wait}

The guardians became
those water beasts?{page_break}Then what changed
them in the first
place?{end_wait}
Did you find ruins\nbeneath the mine?{end_now}
So it's true...\nThere's something\nancient down there.{end_wait}
Are you certain?\nPerhaps someone else\nshould investigate.{end_wait}

The upper mine is
open again.{page_break}There's work to do,
but we'll take it
one shaft at a time.{end_wait}

I feared the beasts
would release more
water when they fell.{page_break}I'm relieved I was
wrong about that.{end_wait}

I hope the mine can
support Altin again.{page_break}We need steady work,
not another rush
for buried riches.{end_wait}

Water soaked the
mine shafts.{page_break}Loose stone could
bring the ceiling
down on us.{end_wait}
It's so humid inside\nthat cave. It feels\nawful and sticky!{end_wait}

There's a chamber
deep in the mine.{page_break}I heard something
strange there. I won't
go back alone.{end_wait}
You stood against\nthose water beasts.{page_break}I wouldn't have had\nthe courage.{end_wait}

The mine has cracks
and deep chasms.{page_break}That's where much
of the floodwater
went.{end_wait}
Those old statues\nalways frightened me.{page_break}I never thought\nI'd see them move.{end_wait}

We found artifacts
while digging.{page_break}Perhaps they came
from the ruins
below the mine.{end_wait}
They say Silk Road\nis blocked.{page_break}A girl from Xian\nbrought the news.{end_wait}

A girl from Xian
was looking for
young warriors.{page_break}Could she have
meant your party?{end_now}
She asked everyone\nwho came through\nthis town.{end_wait}
Then I hope she\nfinds them safely.{end_wait}

The merchants will
suffer if Silk Road
stays closed.{page_break}A landslide is hard
enough to clear
without this rain.{end_wait}
That girl from Xian\nseemed worried.{page_break}Whatever she wants,\nit must be urgent.{end_wait}

Ancient ruins beneath
our mine...{page_break}Some already speak
of treasure, as though
the flood never came.{end_wait}
I almost miss the\nold guardian statues.{page_break}It's strange to see\ntheir places empty.{end_wait}

There are still
monsters deep below.{page_break}No treasure is worth
getting trapped
with them.{end_wait}

I know those beasts
were dangerous.{page_break}Still, I remember
when they were only
statues.{end_wait}
There are ancient\nruins beneath us?{page_break}Then our mine was\nnever just a mine.{end_wait}

There may be treasure
in the ruins.{page_break}But please don't
risk your lives
for a rumour.{end_wait}

Mom and Pop have
been whispering
about the ruins.{page_break}I think they know
something they won't
tell me.{end_wait}

Ruins beneath Altin?
Think of what we
might find!{page_break}No... First we must
make the mine safe.{end_wait}
I never knew there\nwere ruins below\nour mine.{end_wait}
Did Mom and Pop know\nabout the monument\nin the mine?{end_wait}
With Silk Road blocked,\nyou'll need the passage\nthrough the mine.{end_wait}

I've heard there's
a western passage
through the mine.{page_break}I've never met
anyone who found it.{end_wait}
What do you think\nof our armor?{end_wait}
If it suits you,\nconsider buying some.{end_wait}
That girl from Xian\nbought supplies here.{page_break}She seemed ready\nfor a long journey.{end_wait}
The girl from Xian\nbought our damp stock.{page_break}She paid full price.\nI won't forget that.{end_wait}

There's a small temple
west of Altin Mine.{page_break}I wonder whether
the flood reached
that far.{end_wait}

Beyond the mountains
lies a desert.{page_break}Take plenty of water
if you intend
to cross it.{end_wait}

The desert west
of here is brutal.{page_break}Travel early, rest
when you can, and
watch your water.{end_wait}
There are still beasts\nin the lower mine,\naren't there?{end_now}
Then the upper shafts\nmay be safe enough\nto reopen.{end_wait}
Then we must keep\nthe miners out until\nthe beasts are gone.{end_wait}
I think it's called\nLama Temple.{page_break}People say its monks\nknow unusual arts.{end_wait}
Silk Road is blocked.\nYou can't cross it\nfor now.{end_wait}
No one can travel\nwest by Silk Road\nwhile it's blocked.{end_wait}

Altin won't recover
overnight.{page_break}But the water is
falling, and we can
finally begin.{end_wait}
The pots and pans\nare rusted...{end_wait}
